dnsDiagnostics.title: DNS records & DNSSEC
dnsDiagnostics.placeholder: Enter a domain, such as example.com
dnsDiagnostics.description: Query A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, CAA, HTTPS and SVCB records, with the resolver's DNSSEC authentication signal.
dnsDiagnostics.disclaimer: Data comes from Cloudflare public DoH. DNSSEC reflects the recursive resolver's authenticated-data flag and is not a complete domain security audit.
